0022600090.text: The Indiana Pacers and New Orleans Pelicans both open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Pacers on the road. Johnny Furphy is out for the Pacers after knee surgery, while Aaron Nesmith (hamstring), Jarace Walker and T.J. McConnell (both undisclosed) are listed as day-to-day and are game-time decisions, and Dejounte Murray is day-to-day with a toe bruise for New Orleans. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and the Pacers won their most recent meeting 127-119 in Indianapolis on January 16, 2026; ESPN's matchup predictor gives Indiana a 65% chance to win.
